tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so/ /rgya gar skad du/shrī kā la tsakra sā dha nā gu hyartha mā ṇi ga nā maḥbod skad du/dpal dus ka
༄༅/ /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so/ /rgya gar skad du/shrī kā la tsakra sā dha nā gu hyartha mā ṇi ga nā maḥbod skad du/dpal dus ka

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so// rgya gar skad du/ shrī kā la tsakra sā dha nā gu hyartha mā ṇi ga nā maḥ bod skad du/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs gsang ba don gyi nor bu zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /sna tshogs thabs shes zung 'jug bla ma mchog /dbyer med dang po'i sangs rgyas la btud nas/ /de nyid sgrub thabs gsang ba'i nor bu mchog /'gro la brtse ba'i bsam pas bshad kyis nyon/ /'di la sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum mo/ /dang po la kha lag dag pa'i cho ga sku gsung thugs ye shes sbyang ba/ tshogs gnyis bsags pa'i cho ga'o/ /dang po 'jam pa'i stan la kha shar du phyogs pas 'dug ste/ bdud rtsi ril bu khar bcug pa'am/ med na chang gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs nas rdo rje drug gi sngags brjod de mtheb srin gyis lce la bzhag cing / oṃ hraḥsarba asatra rā dza mā ra kle sha ant+ra ka ra tikṣ+ṇa duḥkha tstshāe da mā ma ka raṃ bi sho dha ya swā hā/ zhes brjod de phan tshun lag pa mnyes pas bkrus par bsam mo/ /gnyis pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho haṃ kṣaḥ pradzñau pā ya ātma ka kā ya wākka tsitta dzñā na a dhi pa te mā ma kā ya wākka tsitta dzñā na badzraṃ badzra a mṛ ta swa bhā waṃ ku ru ku ru skandha dhā twa ya ta naṃ niḥswa bhā waṃ swā hā/ zhes brjod de gtsug tor gyi steng du khāṃ yig yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bcu drug yongs su rdzogs pa bsgom ste/ de'i 'od kyi gtsug tor nas rkang sen gyi bar rang gi lus sbrul gyi shun pa brjes pa bzhin du lan gsum dor nas rang lus dus kyi 'khor lo'i skur bsgom ste/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ zhes pas dag pa'i nga rgyal bzung ste lag pa g.yon pa'i mthe chung nas mthe bo'i bar gyi rtsa ba'i tshigs lnga la/ a i ṛ u l̥/

bar tshigs la/ a e ir o al/ rtse mo'i tshigs la/ ha ya ra wa la ste/ dbyangs thung du bco lnga las grub pa'i zla ba cha bco lnga rdzogs pa dang / g.yas kyi mthe bong nas mthe chung gi bar gyi rtse mo'i tshigs la/ lā wā rā yā hā/ bar tshigs la/ āl o ar ai āḥ rtsa ba'i tshigs la/ lī ū ṝ ī ā ste/ dbyangs ring po bco lnga las grub pa'i nyi ma dang / lag pa gnyis kha sbyar ba dang nyi ma'i dbus su hūm̐ sngon po bsam ste/ nyi zla sgra gcan gyi sa bon de dag yongs su gyur pa las lag pa gnyis rdo rje rtse lnga par bsgom la/ lag par sbyar ba'i mthe bong mthe chung so sor rtse sprad/ gung mo mnyam pa'i rgyab tu mdzub mo gnyis phyed 'khyog gi tshul du bzhag ming med 'og tu bskum pa lag mthil du son pa rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya bcings te/ des gtsug tor nas rkang sen gyi bar yan lag thams cad la reg cing / oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho haṃ kṣaḥ kā ya wākka tsitta dzñā na a dhi pa te badzra kā ya mā ma kā ya wākka tsitta dzñā na a dhi pa te badzra kā ya swa bhā waṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ zhes brjod cing / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra kā ya badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes pas rdo rje sku'i nga rgyal bzung ngo / /gsum pa la gnyis kyi/ bsod nams kyi tshogs ni/ rang gi thugs kar paṃ las padma dmar po'i dbus su āḥlas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa las 'od zer kha dog lnga spros pas mdun gyi nam mkhar rgyal ba sras bcas dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par spyan drangs/ 'od zer snying khar zla ba la bsdus te/ stong nyid snying rje'i bdag nyid can/ /srid gsum skye dang 'jig pa med/ /shes dang shes bya gcig pa'i sku/ /dpal ldan dus 'khor la phyag 'tshal/ /zhes sogs kyis phyag byas te/ rang gi snying khar zla ba'i steng du ming yig dang po las byung ba'i mchod yon bsang gtor kyi snod rdzas kakhagaghang kakhagaghang las rol gar ma ljang khu tra pa ṭa hā dang gos bsnams pa tsatshadzadzhanya tsatshadzadzhanya las dri phreng ma nag mo dung chos dang me tog sngon po'i phreng ba bsnams pa/

ṭaṭhaḍaḍhaṇa ṭaṭhaḍaḍhaṇa las spos mar me dmar mo spos snod dang mar me bsnams pa/ paphababham paphababham las bshos ma 'bras bu ma dkar mo bdud rtsi'i snod dang 'bras bu 'dzin pa/ tathadadhan tathadadhan las sgeg bzhad ma ser mo dbu rgyan dang do shal 'dzin pa/ sakapaṣashathakā sakapaṣashathakā las glu 'dod ma sngon mo rdo rje dang padma 'dzin pa spros/ rang rang gi mchod rdzas dang 'dod mas snyoms par 'jug pa'i bde bas mchod par bsam ste/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ oṃ shī kā la tsakra grihna grihna argha kaṃ me pu na ri yaṃ/ de bzhin du arghaṃ kaṃ gi gnas su/ prokṣa naṃ bcug pa dang / oṃ tsatshadzadzñanya badzra gandhe gandha ar tstsha naṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ /de bzhin du oṃ dang ar tstsha sogs sbyar te/ tsatshadzadzhanyā/ badzra mā le yā la/ ṭaṭhaḍadhaṇa badzra dhū pe dhū pa/ ṭaṭhaḍaḍhaṇa pra dī pe pra dī pa/ paphababhamā badzra a mṛ te nai baitya/ pū dzaṃ/ paphababhamā badzra akṣa te akṣa ta pha la ar tstsha/ ta tha da dha na badzra la sye wasatwa a bha ra ṇa pū/ ta tha da dha na badzra hā sye/ ghaṇṭa ā dar sha pū/ kakhagaghang badzra nṛ tyaṃ nṛ tya pū/ kakhagaghang badzra bidyā byidyā pū/ sakapaṣashakā badzra gī ti gi ta pū/ oṃ sakapaṣashakā badzra kā me sarba buddha naṃ bho dhi kro dha/ dhā dī nāṃ badzra su ra ta pū dzaṃ a ratstsha ku ru ku ru swā hā/ zhes pas mchod nas/ thog med dus nas lus ngag yid kyis sdig pa rnam pa mang po bshags par bgyi/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang 'phags pa'i tshogs kyi rnam mang dge ba gang byas pa/ /de dag mtha' dag la ni sdig pa rnam bral byang chub spyod la rjes su gnas pas rjes yi rangs/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun srid pa'i 'jig 'phrog la yang byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /'gro ba'i nyon mongs nad kyi bsal slad rdo rje theg pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas su bdag gyur cig ces 'dir ni smon lam sems can don gyi slad du bdag bgyi'o/

/rtsa ba gsum dang pha rol phyin bcu tshad med bsdu dngos la gnas mi dge bcu las ldog par gyis/ /sgrib pa lnga dang nyon mongs rnam bzhi zag pa bzhi po rnam spangs rnam par thar pa bsgom par bgyi/ /zhes don dran pas brjod do/ /ye shes kyi tshogs ni/ dngos po med la sgom pa med/ /sgom pa sgom pa nyid la min/ /de ltar dngos po dngos min 'gyur/ /sgom pa dmigs su med pa'o/ /zhes pas chos thams cad rgyu 'bras ngo bo gsum gyis stong pa'i mtshan nyid du bltas la/ 'khor ba'i phung po'i ngar 'dzin spang zhing / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i phung po bzung ba'i phyir chus me nyams par byas/ me dang bral ba'i sa chu la thim/ chu rlung gis bskams/ rlung nam mkha' la thim ste/ sems kun gzhi'i rnam shes nam mkha'i khams rnam pa thams cad pa'i rang bzhin du bsgoms la/ oṃ shūn+ya ta dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ de bzhin du/ oṃ dang dzñā sogs sbyar te/ a ni mitta dzñā/ a pra ni hi ta/ a na bhi saṃskā ra/ zhes brjod nas/ khams gsum po rdul phra rab kyi chos nyid las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyi gzugs su bsgom mo/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog las rgyal mchog thig le'i rnal 'byor/ phra mo'i rnal 'byor dang bzhi'i/ dang po la rten dang brten pa gnyis kyi/ dang po ni/ nam mkha'i khams mtha' yas pa'i rang bzhin gyi chos 'byung gi nang du/ yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag po dbus su gzhu'i rnam pa thad kar dpag tshad 'bum phrag bzhi pa rgyal mtshan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum rgyar dpag tshad 'bum phrag gsum pa nor bus mtshan pa/ de'i steng du baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po rgyar dpag tshad 'bum phrag gnyis pa padmas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi rgyar dpag tshad 'bum phrag gcig pa rdo rjes mtshan pa/

so so'i steng 'og tu hūm̐ hūm̐ las skyes pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje gnyis gnyis kyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du maṃ las lhun po rdo rje'i rang bzhin/ 'og gi rgyar dpag tshad stong phrag bcu drug dang / steng la dpag tshad stong phrag lnga bcu pa de'i dbus su kṣaṃ las padma ljang khu de'i phyed dang mnyam pa'i sum cha lte ba la yod pa'i steng du haṃ las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor de dang mnyam pa/ de'i steng du tsheg drag las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor zla ba dang mnyam pa/ de'i steng du thig le las sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor sngon po nyi ma dang mnyam pa/ de rnams gcig tu 'dres pas ham̐kṣamalawarya gi yi ger bsgom zhing / de yongs su gyur pa las 'byung bzhi lhun po padma zla nyi sgra gcan dang bcas pa grub pa'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje'i gur gyi nang rdo rje'i sa gzhi'i dbus su/ oṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor mthar thug par nor bu'i 'od zer 'phro ba/ phyi nas dkar dmar nag pa'i rtsig pa gsum dang ldan pa/ gru bzhi/ sgo bzhi pa/ ka ba ser po gnyis gnyis kyis btegs pa'i nor bu gser gyi rang bzhin gyi rta babs kyis brgyan pa rta babs so so la ka ba bzhi bzhi'i bar du lha mo'i gnas gsum gsum dang ldan pa'i brtseg ma gsum pa'i 'og gi snam bur/ glang po che'i mgo bor seng ges mnan pa dang / bar dang steng gi snam bu shā la bhiñdza kas btegs pa/ snam bu so so'i rtse mor rgyal mtshan bsgreng ba/ rnga yab/ me long / dril bu/ ba dan dkar po 'phyang ba/ steng du har mi/ de'i steng gi dbus su bum pa/ g.yas g.yon du rgyal mtshan bsgreng ba/ ka ba'i gsham nas myos pa bsrung ba dang / phyi rol na 'dod yon gyi snam bu dkar pos bskor zhing / rtsig pa'i steng du rin po che'i snam bu dmar po rin po che 'ching bas rnam par bkra ba sgo khyud ka ba'i mtshams su rin po che dang / zur bzhir sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/

/do shal dang do shal phyed pa/ me long rnga yab la sogs pas spras pa/ bya 'dab las 'phyang ba'i bā ku li dkar po/ steng du kra ma ṣīr ṣa padma'i 'dab ma phyed pa'i dbyibs can gyis bskor ba'i bar bar du rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan la sogs pas mdzes pa/ nang gi dbus kyi sa gzhi ljang / steng thog sngo/ shar nag lho ser nub dmar/ byang ljang / nub ser ba'i dbus su rdo rje'i phreng ba ljang khus bskor ba/ oṃ las sna tshogs padma'i rtsa ba sdong bu 'dab ma ge sar bcas pa'i lte bar aṃ āḥ a las zla nyi sgra gcan gyis dkyil 'khor/ gzhal yas khang gi phyi nas sa chu me rlung gi khor yug bzhis bskor ba'i sa yi dbang ldan du oṃ las zla ba/ srin por āḥlas nyi ma/ nam mkha'i khor yug la rdo rje'i ra ba/ phyi rol 'od zer 'bar bas bskor bar bsam mo/ /gnyis pa las/ gtso bo mngon byang las skyes/ mngal nas dkyil 'khor spro/ 'gro la snying rje'i dbang bskur/ dag pa'i nga rgyal bzung ba'o/ /dang po ni/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du a i ṛ u l̥/ a e ar o al/ ha ya ra wa la/ aṃ rnams g.yon bskor/ lā wā rā yā hā/ al au ar ai ā/ l̥̄ u ṝ ī āḥ rnams g.yas skor/ mtshan so gnyis kyi ngo bo yongs su gyur pa zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbyangs so gnyis kyis mtshan pa me long lta bu'i ye shes/ de'i 'og tu/ lla wwa yya ḍhḍa ḍḍa/ lla wwa rar yya haha/ ssa kapa kapa ṣṣa shsha thaka thaka/ tta thathadda dhadha nna/ ppa phapha bba bhabha mma/ ṭṭa thatha ḍḍa ḍhḍa ṇṇa/ tstsa tshtsha dzdza dzhdza nynya/ kka khkha gga ghga ngnga rnams g.yas bskor/ nga gha ga kha ka nya dzha dza tsha tsa/ ṇa ḍha ḍa ṭha ṭa/ ma bha ba pha pa/ na dha da tha ta/ thaka sha ṣa kapa sa/ ha ya ra wa la/ ḍa ḍha ya wa la/ rnams g.yon skor dpe byad brgyad cu'i ngo bo yongs su gyur pa'i nyi ma ka lis mtshan pa mnyam nyid ye shes/ zla ba'i dbus su hūm̐ yig zla ba'i kha dog lta bu sor rtog ye shes/ zla nyi sa bon rnams gcig tu 'dres pa srog rlung gi sa bon hi yig dang ldan pa bya grub ye shes de gyur pa las rnam shes kyi sa bon haṃ yig du grub pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/

de las byung ba'i bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lo dri ma med pa'i 'od zer lnga 'phro ba/ sku lus byings sngon po/ mgrin pa gsum gyis dbus sngo/ g.yas dmar/ g.yon dkar/ rtsa zhal nag cing mche ba gtsigs pa/ g.yas zhal dmar po chags pa dang bcas pa/ rgyab zhal ser po ting nge 'dzin la gnas pa/ g.yon zhal dkar po rab tu zhi ba/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ ral pa'i cod pan la sna tshogs rdo rje dang / zla ba phyed pa dang / rdo rje sems dpa'i dbu rgyan can/ rdo rje nor bu/ rna rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ gdub bu/ ska rags/ rkang gdub/ dar dpyangs/ rdo rje phreng ba/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs dgrol ba/ g.yas g.yon gyi phrag pa mdun sngo/ bar pa dmar/ rgyab dkar ba'i phrag pa drug dpung pa bcu gnyis/ phyag nyer bzhi'i mdun ma bzhi nag bar pa bzhi dmar/ rgyab ma bzhi dkar ba'i mthe bong ser/ mdzub mo dkar/ gung mo dmar/ ming med nag mthe chung ljang / sor tshigs kyi phreng ba rtsa ba nag bar pa dmar/ rtse mo dkar ba/ rdo rje'i sor gdub kyi spras pa las 'od zer 'phro ba/ g.yas kyi phyag nag po bzhir rdo rje/ ral gri/ rtse gsum/ gri gug dmar po bzhir mda' gsum/ rdo rje lcags kyu/ sgra dang bcas pa'i ḍa ma ru/ tho ba/ dkar po bzhir 'khor lo/ mdung / dbyug pa/ dgra sta/ g.yon gyi nag po bzhir rdo rje dril bu/ phub/ kha traṃ ga rnam par rgyab pa/ khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/ dmar po bzhir gzhu/ rdo rje zhags pa/ rin chen/ pad dkar/ dkar po bzhir mdung / me long / rdo rje lcags sgrog tshangs pa'i mgo bor gdong bzhi bsnams pa/ zla nyi sgra gcan gyi steng du shin tu rol pa'i g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa'i zhabs g.yas dmar pos 'dod lha dmar po gdong gcig pa/ lag pa bzhi'i dang po gnyis kyis me tog gi mda' lnga/ gzhu/ 'og mas zhags pa/ lcags kyu 'dzin pa dang / g.yon dkar pos drag po dkar po gdong gcig mig gsum/

g.yas gnyis rtse gsum ḍa ma ru/ g.yon gnyis thod pa/ kha traṃ ga 'dzin pa brdzis pa/ bdud dang drag po'i lha mo dga' ma dang / u mas zhabs kyi mthil la 'dzin zhing gdong dman par byed bzhin pa/ de la mdun nas 'khyud pa'i sna tshogs yum gser mdog g.yas skor gyi ser/ dkar sngo/ dmar ba'i zhal bzhi re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag brgyad kyi g.yas na gri gug lcags kyu/ sgra bcas ḍa ma ru/ bgrang phreng / g.yon na thod pa/ zhags pa/ pad dkar 'dab brgyad/ rin po che rdo rje sems dpa'i cod pan can/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bcom ldan 'das dang snyoms par 'jug pa/ shar gyi pad 'dab la nag mo 'bar ma nag mo/ nag dmar/ ser/ dkar ba'i zhal bzhi/ phyag brgyad kyi g.yas spos/ tsan dan/ gur gum/ ga pur dang gla tsi sbyar ba'i snod/ g.yon dril bu/ padma/ yongs 'du'i me tog me tog sna tshogs pa'i phreng ba 'dzin pa/ lhor dmar mo 'bar ma dmar mo/ dmar/ ser/ dkar/ sngo ba'i zhal/ g.yas mar me/ do shal/ cod pan/ gdub bu/ g.yon gos/ ska rags/ rna rgyan/ rkang gdub 'dzin pa/ byang du dkar mo 'bar ma dkar mo/ dkar nag dmar ser zhi ba'i zhal bzhi/ g.yas 'o ma/ chu/ mchog gi sman/ chang gi snod/ g.yon bdud rtsi/ grub pa'i ro/ bdud rtsi'i 'bras bu/ zan gyi snod 'dzin pa/ nub tu ser mo 'bar ma ser mo/ ser/ dkar/ sngo/ dmar ba'i zhal can/ g.yas dung / gling bu/ ḍa ma ru/ nor bu/ g.yon pi waṃ/ rnga/ sgra sgrogs 'khar ba zang dung 'dzin pa/ mer du ba ma nag mo 'bar ma lta bu/ phyag na rnga yab nag po brgyad/ srin por smig rgyu ma dmar mo 'bar ma lta bu rnga yab dmar po brgyad/ dbang ldan mkha' nang ma dkar mo 'bar ma lta bu rnga yab dkar po brgyad/ rlung du mar me ma ser mo 'bar ma lta bu rnga yab ser po brgyad 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ rdo rje sems dpa'i cod pan can/

mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ zur bzhi'i dbang ldan du chos kyi dung dkar po/ /bden bral du chos kyi gaṇṭi dmar po/ mer nor bu nag po/ rlung du dpag gsam gyi shing ser po bsam mo/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'dod chags chen pos gdul bar bya ba'i sems can gyi 'jig rten dang po'i sangs rgyas bstan par bya ba'i snod du mngon par gzigs nas yum dang sbyar bas shin tu dga' ba'i sgras rgyal ba lnga yum lnga sems ma rnams spyan drangs/ rang lus la zhugs/ slar yang rang lus las spros/ yum gyi sku la zhugs pa mkha' nang nas spros/ phung khams skye mched dang bcas pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i rnam pa rnams rang lus la zhugs te khu ba'i rang bzhin du zhu ba rnams yum gyi padma'i nang du rdo rje nas spros pa rang rang gi sa bon dang de dag yongs su gyur pa las lha dang lha mo'i tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor rten gdan/ brten pa lha'i mtshan nyid mi bskyod pa'i ngo bo'i gtso bo dkyil 'khor gyi bdag por gyur pa hūm̐ dang rdo rje las skyes pa dang / de dang dus mnyam du phreṃ dang gri gug las sna tshogs yum/ a dang spos snod las nag mo 'bar ma/ āḥdang mar me las dmar mo 'bar ma/ aṃ las lha bshos las dkar mo 'bar ma/ ā dang dung las ser mo 'bar ma/ ha dang rnga yab nag po las du ba ma/ haḥdang rnga yab dmar po las mig rgyu ma/ haṃ dang rnga yab dkar po las mkha' snang ma/ ha dang rnga yab ser po las mar me ma/ oṃ las dung / āḥlas gaṇḍi/ hūm̐ las nor bu/ ho las dpag bsam shing rnams bskyed/ mngal nas spros/ gtso bo dang yum rnams dang mtshan ma so so la bzhugs/ gsum pa ni/ rang ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid dus kyi 'khor lo rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan/ chos dbyings ye shes kyi ngo bo'i thugs kha'i zla ba'i steng gi rdo rje lte ba'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas 'gro ba drug gi sems can rnams bkug

dkyil 'khor de nyid du bcug pa la thugs kha'i 'od kyi rigs lnga yab yum spyan drangs la rang gi snying khar bcug byang chub kyi sems su zhu bar gyur pa rang gi gsang ba nas spros/ dbang bskur bas/ byang chub kyi sems kyis 'od zer gyis reg pa'i sems can de thams cad zhal gsum pa dang / zhal dang sku'i kha dog sna tshogs pa'i lha shes rab thams cad kyi bdag nyid can mchog gi bde ba'i dga' bas gang bar gyur pa de rnams kyi phung po lnga/ kṣa kṣi kṣ+r-i kṣu kṣl̥ las gshegs pa lnga/ khams lnga kṣā kṣi kṣṝ kṣū kṣl̥̄ las gshegs ma lnga/ dbang po drug kṣa kṣe kṣar kṣo kṣal kṣaṃ las sems dpa' drug las dbang lnga/ kṣaha kṣ+ya kṣ+ra kṣ+wakṣ+la las khro bo lnga/ bya ba lnga kṣahā kṣ+yā kṣ+rā kṣ+wā kṣ+lā las khro mo lnga te/ mtshan so gnyis kyi rang bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor gyi lhar gyur te rang rang gi zhing du gshegs par bsam mo/ /bzhi pa ni lha thams cad chos dbyings ye shes kyi ngo bor mos pas/ oṃ su bi shuddha dharma dhā tu swa bhā wa ā tma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod de nga rgyal bzung ngo / /gnyis pa las rgyal mchog la/ glus bskul te bzhengs pa/ mngal nas dkyil 'khor spro ba/ rdo rje bzhi yis rgyas gdab pa/ ye shes dgug cing ro mnyam/ sgo gsum byin gyis brlab/ dbang bskur zhing rgyas gdab/ lha'i rnam dag sgom pa dang bdun gyi dang po ni/ rang gi dpral bar sku rdo rje oṃ/ mgrin par gsung rdo rje āḥ snying khar thugs rdo rje hūm̐/ gtsug tor dang lte ba'i a wa dhū ti'i nang du ye shes rdo rje ho yig bkod de/ ho yig shes rab gtum mo'i me chags pa'i 'od zer gyis rdo rje can shes rab nu ma dang bcas pa ri bong 'dzin pa bzhin du zhu ba la/ tshad med bzhi'i rang bzhin gyi lha mo bzhis glus bskul bar bsam zhing / bcom ldan gtso bo khyab bdag rdo rje 'dzin pa khyod ni sems can kun la phan par mdzad pa po/

/bdag cag srungs shig lha mi'i bla ma rdo rje ldan pa 'dod pa don gnyer rnams la 'dod pa mdzod/ /ces brjod pas/ stong pa nyid la zhugs pa'i bcom ldan 'das sad de/ /'gro ba mtha' dag sgyu ma lta bur gzigs nas/ zla ba zhu ba de las hūm̐ yig sngon po dri ma med pa'i 'od zer 'phro ba yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ de gyur pa las dus kyi 'khor lo mi bskyod pa'i cod pan dang / yum nus ma dang bcas pa sa bon phyag mtshan las sngar bzhin bskyed pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni gtso bo yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas dkyil 'khor lnga'i rang bzhin gyi sangs rgyas nam mkhar bzhugs pa rnams phung khams skye mched la sogs pa'i lha'i rnam par gnas pa rang lus la bcug byang sems su zhu ba yum gyi padmar lha so so'i sa bon de las phyag mtshan/ de lha'i skur gyur pa las/ hūm̐ dang rdo rje las skyes pa'i gtso bo mi bskyod pa'i ngo bo rdor sems kyi cod pan la sogs pa dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog bzhin spros/ gtso bo yab yum la zhugs/ zhes pa nas/ 'bras bu ma'i bar so so la zhugs ces ngag tu brjod cing yid kyis bsam mo/ /gsum pa ni/ lha rnams kyi gtsug tor gyi 'khor lo thig le ljang khu la a/ snying khar sgra gcan la i/ dpral bar zla ba la u/ lte bar dus mer laṃ/ mgrin par nyi ma la raṃ/ gsang bar ye shes la aṃ/ lte ba'i rlung la sar l̥/ snying kha'i la chur u/ mgrin pa'i la mer ṛ/ dpral ba'i la rlung du i/ gtsug tor du nam mkha'i rlung la nam mkha'i dkyil du a/ sems kyi bdag nyid dpral ba'i thig ler zla ba la oṃ/ mgrin pa'i nyi mar āḥ snying kha'i sgra gcan la hūm̐/ lte ba'i thig ler dus me la hoḥ nor bu la a bsams te sku gsung thugs ye shes kyi rgyas btab pas/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha mtha' dag sku bzhi dang rdo rje bzhi'i bdag nyid kyi thabs shes su mos par bya'o/ /bzhi pa ni/

rang gi snying khar zla nyi sgra gcan gyi steng gi hūm̐ yig las byung ba'i rdo rje'i lte bar dzaḥyig las skyes pa'i rdo rje lcags kyu spros pas srid pa gsum gyi rnam pa can shin tu dang ba'i ye shes kyi 'khor lo bkug a wa dhū tī'i sgo nas gtsug tor nas gsang bar zhugs/ byang sems su zhu ba yum gyi padmar hūm̐ yig dang de las rdo rjer gyur pa las skyes pa'i rdo rje shugs 'od zer sngon po 'jigs pa'i sku/ rab tu bzhad pa'i zhal bzhi mche ba gtsigs pa/ sgra drag po sgrog pa spyan bcu gnyis pa/ zhabs gnyis pa/ shes rab dang thabs las rab tu byung ba/ phyag nyi shu rtsa drug pa/ gtso bo bzhin du mtshon cha dang bcas pa phyag lhag ma gnyis sdigs mdzub dang bcas pas glang po che'i lpags pa'i gos 'dzin pa/ phyag rgya lngas rgyan pa/ mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ thod pa dang mgo bo'i phreng ba 'dzin pa/ sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ rkang pa brgyad pa'i shing rta la gnas pa dbugs phyir 'byung ba dang lhan cig spros te/ lcags kyu'i phyag rgya dang dzaḥ ces brjod pas des ye shes pa'i gtso bo'i lte bar rdo rje lcags kyus bsnun/ phyag rnams zhags pas bcings/ mtshon cha lhag ma rnams kyis 'jigs par byas te mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs nas rdo rje shugs rang gi snying khar thim par lta'o/ /de la lha mo bcu gnyis kyis mchod de hūm̐ yig dang rdo rje'i phyag rgyas khro bo rmugs byed gyi lha so so la bzhugs/ baṃ dang zhags pa'i phyag rgya khro bo rengs byed kyis dbyer med du bcings/ hoḥdang dril bu'i phyag rgyas khro bo khengs byed kyis mnyes par byas/ hī dang byug pa'i phyag rgyas khro bo shin tu stobs kyis ro mnyam par bya ste/ de yang nang du zla nyi sgra gcan dus me 'dus pa lta bu/ dbus kyi lte bar gtso bo yab yum la ye shes pa yab yum ro mnyam pa nas/ sa'i dkyil 'khor gyi zla nyi la zla nyi ro mnyam pa'i bar ngag tu brjod cing bsam par bya'o/

/lnga pa ni/ lha thams cad kyi dpral bar a las zla bar oṃ las 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa gyur pa'i sku rdo rje dkar po dkar/ nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gis g.yas 'khor lo/ padma/ rdo rje/ g.yon ral gri/ nor bu/ dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum gsung rdo rje lta bus 'khyud par gyur pa spros/ de las de lta bu dpag med byung / nam mkha'i khams gang bas sku rdo rjes gdul ba'i sems can la chos bstan/ slar 'dus gcig tu gyur mdun du bzhugs pa la/ sku rdo rje 'dzin pas bdag la dbang bskur du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sku'i rigs kyi lha mo rnams kyis bdud rtsi'i bum pas dbang bskur/ dpral ba'i zla ba la 'khod par mos la/ dpal ldan sku yi rdo rje 'dzin/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgom pas/ /sku yi rdo rje can gyi ni/ /byin rlabs gnas su deng bdag mdzod/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas/ /sku yi rdo rje can gyis ni/ /byin rlabs gnas su deng bdag mdzod/ /ces gsol ba btab pas ro mnyam ste lus sku rdo rjer gyur par bsam/ mgrin par raṃ las nyi mar a las padma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad par gyur pa'i gsung rdo rje dmar po dmar/ dkar/ nag pa'i zhal/ g.yas padma rdo rje 'khor lo/ g.yon nor bu/ dril bu/ ral gri 'dzin pa/ yum sku rdo rje lta bus 'khyud pa dang bcas par gyur pa spros/ de las de lta bu dpag med byung nam mkha'i khams gang bas gsung rdo rjes 'dul ba'i sems can la chos bstan/ slar 'dus gcig tu gyur/ mdun du bzhugs pa la/ gsung rdo rje 'dzin pas bdag la dbang bskur du gsol zhes brjod pas/ gsung gi rigs kyi lha mo rnams kyis bdud rtsi'i bum pas dbang bskur/ mgrin par padma la 'khod par mos la/ dpal ldan gsung gi rdo rje 'dzin/ sems su 'don pa bsgyur nas gsol ba btab pas ro mnyam ste/

ngag gsung rdo rjer gyur/ snying khar thig le las sgra gcan sngon po hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa gyur pa'i thugs rdo rje nag po/ nag dmar/ dkar ba'i zhal g.yas rdo rje/ padma/ 'khor lo/ g.yon dril bu/ nor bu/ ral gri 'dzin pa/ yum ser mo/ ser/ dmar/ dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas nor bu/ rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ g.yon padma/ dril bu ral gri can dang bcas par gyur pa spros/ de las de lta bu dpag med byung nam mkha'i khams gang bas thugs rdo rjes gdul ba'i sems can la chos bstan/ slar 'dus gcig tu gyur mdun du bzhugs pa la/ thugs rdo rje 'dzin pas bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes pas thugs kyi rigs kyi lha mo rnams kyis bdud rtsi'i bum pas dbang bskur/ snying kha sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor la 'khod par mos la/ dpal ldan thugs kyi rdo rje 'dzin/ sogs kyi gsol ba btab pas ro mnyam ste sems thugs rdo rjer gyur par bsam ste/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wāka tsitta swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes pas de'i nga rgyal bzung zhing / khyad par yum gyi lte bar hoḥ gsang bar swa/ gtsug tor la hā bsam mo/ /drug pa ni/ rang gi snying kha'i padma dang zla ba'i steng gi rdo rje lte ba'i hūm̐ las spros pa'i 'od kyi nam mkhar rgyal ba sras bcas dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par spyan drangs pa la lha mo bcu gnyis kyi mchod nas/ oṃ haṃ hāṃ hiṃ hīṃ hriṃ hrīṃ huṃ hūm̐ hl̥ṃ hlīṃ/ ā ī ṝ u li badzra ḍā ki n+yau badzra a mṛ ta gha ṭai ra a bhi ṣiñtsan tu maṃ swā hās gsol ba btab pas/ yum lngas/ oṃ ā ī ṛ u li pañtsa dhā tu bi sho dha ni swā hā/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis dbang bskur dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ yab la bla ma dang dbyer med pa'i mi bskyod pa ljang khu dang / yum la rdor sems sngon po gnyis ka sprul pa'i sku sa gnon dang mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya can gyis rgyas btab bo/

/bdun pa ni/ dus kyi dag pa dpal ldan rdo rje can gyur mi bdag lo dang zla ba la sogs dbye ba sogs/ /thugs kyi rnam pa nyi ma ma yin nyin zhag so so dbang gis sna tshogs yum ni rnam par dag /rlung gi dag pas du ba la sogs rang gi snying kha'i padmar rtsa yi 'khor lo la gnas rnams/ nyon mongs rnams kyis drag po chung mar bcas pa khyab bdag zhabs kyi 'og tu bdud kyi tshogs kyi 'dud/ dung dang gaṇṭi ma ṇi ljon pa zhes pa dag kyang de bzhin sku yi rdo rje la sogs kyis/ /bum pa brgyad ni bdud rtsi'i yan lag gis te rgyal dang rnam rgyal bum pa byang chub la sogs kyis/ /'du byed don yod grub pa tshor ba dri med nor bu'i phyag dang 'du shes snang ba mtha' yas te/ /gzugs ni 'khor lo can no ri bong can dang stobs khrag bshang ba gci ba rnam par dag pa'o/ /lha mo drug ni khams rnams kyis te yul dang yul can rnams ni byang chub sems dpa' phyag rgyas bcas/ /khro bo lnga ni stobs rnams kyis te nges par slar yang gzhan pa lnga ni dbang po gzhan rnams ni/ /zhes brjod de dag pa dran par bya'o/ /gsum pa thig le'i rnal 'byor ni/ yab yum gyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying khar hūm̐/ lte bar ho/ gsang bar swā/ gtsug tor du hā/ yab kyi rdo rje hūm̐ las skyes pa'i rdo rje a las skyes pa'i padmas mtshan pa/ yum gyi mkha' a las skyes pa'i padma hūm̐ las skyes pa'i rdo rjes mtshan par bsams nas snyoms par zhugs pas lte ba'i gtum mo'i me 'bar te/ haṃ las byang chub kyi sems zhu ba mar babs pa'i dga' ba bzhi nyams su myong bar bsam pa ni thig le'i rnal 'byor ro/ /bzhi pa phra mo'i rnal 'byor ni/ de nas byang sems de nyid ji ltar 'ongs pa bzhin du gsang ba lte bar byon pa rgyu mthun/ snying khar rnam smin/ mgrin par skyes bu byed pa/ dpral bar dri ma med pa'i tshul gyi byon pa las pra phab pa lta bu'i ye shes kyi 'khor los spros/

khams gsum gyi sems can gyi sgo gsum rdo rje gsum du gyur par dmigs nas oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ā nu rā ga ṇa badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ gsum pa rjes kyi cho ga la sngags bzlas/ mchod pa/ bstod pa/ gshegs su gsol/ smon lam/ bkra shis/ bdag bsrung / thun mtshams kyi bya ba drug gis dang po ni/ lha rnams kyi thugs kar phyag g.yas kyi phyag mtshan dang po'i lte bar sa bon la rang rang gi sngags bkod/ las mthun gyi phreng ba byin gyis brlabs te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho ham̐kṣamalawarya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ hrāṃ hrīṃ hraṛ hrarūṃ hriṃl hraḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes pas gtso bo'i snying po dang / nye snying dang / oṃ phreṃ bi shwa mā ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bzlas so/ /gnyis pa la gsum gyi mchod pa ni/ mchod rdzas rnams mdun du bshams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho haṃ kṣa hraḥphaṭa kyis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs pa'i ngang las mchod rdzas dang lha mo rnams sngar bzhin bskyed la mchod/ gnyis pa nang mchod ni/ gtor ma ltar byin rlabs byas/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis lan gsum dkrugs/ dbus nas blangs te sa la chos 'byung gru gsum gyi thig le ltar zlum por bskor ba byas la/ der ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor dwang zhing gzugs brnyan dang mtshungs pa bsgom la/ phud gtor zhing / oṃ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs ye shes rdo rje'i ngo bo/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la na maḥ de bzhin du mgor aṃ dang mthar na maḥ sbyar la/ dang po'i sangs rgyas dus kyi 'khor lo la na maḥ zhes sogs bla ma brgyud pa la 'bul/ rgyud sde bzhi sde snod gsum dang 'brel ba'i dbang rgyud man ngag gzhung 'grel thob pa'i dus gsum gyi bla ma dam pa rnams la na maḥ shrī kā la tsakra ya na maḥ oṃ bi shwa mā tā yai na maḥ

oṃ shrī kā la tsakra badzra bhai ra ba yā na maḥ gu ru buddha bo dhi sa twe bhyoḥn maḥ badzra ḍā ki ni bhyo na maḥ sems can thams cad dus kyi 'khor lo'i lha tshogs su gsal ba la na maḥ gsum pa bstod pa ni/ stong nyid snying rje'i bdag nyid can/ /srid gsum skye dang 'jig pa med/ /shes dang shes bya gcig pa'i sku/ /dpal ldan dus 'khor la phyag 'tshal/ /skye ba dang ni 'jigs pa spangs/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis skyed mdzad ma/ /kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa can/ /sna tshogs yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes brjod/ yig brgya bzlas te nongs pa bzod par gsol nas mngon par 'dod pa'i dngos grub blang ngo / /gsum pa ni/ rdor dril 'dzin pas rdo rje bcings la/ sangs rgyas yab yum bcas pa sras dang g.yog 'khor dang / /grogs bcas gnyen rnams dag gis bskor ba'i tshogs pa ni/ /lha dang lha mo dag gis mnyes par byed rnams dang / /mchog gi rdo rje sems dpa' dag ni gshegs su gsol/ /zhes pas dbugs nang du 'jug pa dang bstun te/ gtsug tor du rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i lte bar bde chen 'khor lo/ snying khar rtse dgu pa'i lte bar nus ma bsdu/ lag pa'i rgyab bstan pa'i se gol gdab pa lan gsum gyis 'jig rten pa rnams rang gnas su gshegs par bsam mo/ /bzhi pa ni/ ji ltar nyi ma dang bcas thub pa'i rigs ni shes rab ye shes thob pa 'di las byung gyur pa/ /rnam gsum srid pa la gnas sems can rnams ni dus kyi 'khor lo'i drin las de bzhin 'gyur bar shog /ces dge ba bsngos la/ gang dag steng na bdud kyi phyogs gnas lha ma yin rnams mchog tu 'jigs byed byang chub sems dpa' rnams/ /mi g.yo 'jig rten dag na phyogs dang phyogs bral du gnas khro bo'i rgyal po btsun mor bcas pa rnams/ /gang dag sa 'og dag na gdengs can dbang po gdon tshogs mi dge thams cad dus su 'ching byed pa/ /de dag thams cad nyin zhag so so'i dus su mi shes 'jig rten kun nas skyong bar byed gyur cig

/ces pas shis pa brjod do/ /lnga pa ni/ rang gi snying khar/ oṃ hriṃlā na maḥdapral bar oṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ gtsug tor du oṃ hrariṃ bau ṣaṭa/ yan lag la oṃ hrīṃ hūm̐/ mig la oṃ hraṃ wa ṣaṭa/ phyogs mtshams kun tu/ oṃ hra phaṭa/ ces pa yan lag drug gi go bkon te/ lha'i rnam pa las langs la spyod lam bzhi po thams cad du lha'i nga rgyal gyis gnas par bya'o/ /drug pa ni/ srung 'khor bsdus pa ltar khro bo dang zhing skyong gzhi bdag la gtor ma thun mtshams su sbyin/ kha zas kyi rnal 'byor gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs te phud oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis sngags nas/ bla ma dang 'dod lha la gtor ma dbul/ de nas/ oṃ ha ri hi piṇḍa ke pra titstsha swā hās/ 'phrog ma la chang bu gnyis byin nas/ bza' ba'i mtha' ji srid par sa la bzhag ste/ lha'i rnal 'byor gyi zas zos pa'i lhag ma oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi u tsiṣṭa ba liṃ bhakṣa si swā hā/ 'byung po rnams la byin nas dge ba bsngos la spyod lam la 'jug nyal ba'i tshe lha bsdus te 'od gsal du gnyid cing / tho rangs sad pa na kha zas kyi rnal 'byor bya ste/ mjug bsngo ba nas bsrung ba'i bar du byed la mdun bskyed mchod na/ mdun du maṇḍal byas nas gshegs su gsol ba'i mthar maṇḍal mdun bskyed bya/ mchod bstod gtor ma 'bul ba sogs gong bzhin bya'o/ /tshul 'dis gtso bo la nus ma brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgom na dngos grub gnyis thob par 'gyur ro/ ༈ /rgyal ba kun gyi gsung rab bcud kyi don/ /gsang chen rgya mtsho'i snying po gnyis med rgyud/ /dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo sgrub pa'i thabs/ /gsang ba don gyis nor bu brtsams pa las/ /byung ba'i dge ba kunda ltar dkar des/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba'i snying gi mun bsal nas/ /rnam pa kun mkhyen go 'phang myur thob cing / /nges don bstan pa yun du gnas gyur cig /ces pa 'di ni dpal mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas la sogs pa zab don gyi gnad mtha' dag thugs su chud cing /
